scope: Actual bundled mashup controls, bounded donor/recipe reads, seeded preview, locks, explicit Apply, Undo/Redo, Save As, stale races and input ownership. No browser or hardware acceptance claim.

results.name: SCENE mashup mounts once with visible native file and seed inputs and no implicit capture
Missing base, cancelled selection and invalid donor types preserve project and pool
Donor batches validate atomically and deduplicate identical content
Visible capture, source choice and static preview preserve authoring, history and emulator
Same seed and sources reproduce byte-identical candidate and recipe downloads
Locks retain the previous source during shuffle until unlocked
Shuffle unlocked resets explicit and recipe-resolved unlocked choices to random
A keep-current preview reports no effective change and disables Apply
Cancelling confirmation preserves the preview and complete Undo history
Apply changes only the chosen background and mirror and one Undo/Redo restores exact data
A nonactive target leaves active scene mirrors and selection untouched
An edited native ROM session survives mashup preview and Apply
Ordinary edits, replaced identical projects and edits in confirmation reject stale Apply
Delayed donor reads reject project and option races with no partial source publication
Delayed preview and replay reject changed project or options before mutation
Blank, whitespace and oversized seeds are rejected
Notification and refresh faults keep committed edits dirty and Undoable
A failed snapshot restores history before assigning candidate data
Candidate and recipe downloads use protected Save As without applying changes
Downloaded recipes load a verified preview, with Apply remaining explicit
Wrong, incomplete or mismatched recipes cannot replace a valid preview
Delayed recipe reads reject changed options and projects
Save As busy, cancellation, failure and stale completion report accurate outcomes
Recapture preserves donors, while clearing donors invalidates the old preview
Inputs retain native keyboard defaults and release active emulator controls
